title: Projektetage Intro Vertical Spacing
description: Fix projektetage intro (about us / authors / affiliations): vertical spacing between text blocks is too large and content shoots off the screen.
summary: Fixed projektetage intro (about us) shooting off screen: compact intro CSS targeted `[data-auto-animate-id^="intro--"]` but German decks use `einleitung--m0`, so h2 kept 20px bottom margins. Added language-independent `presentation-arrangement--intro` class via `isIntroArrangementId`, retargeted globals.css (incl. h2 margins), tests updated. Verified in browser: content height fits slide.
